text.obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_447_: * That's it^1, Kris^1! If we can get its crown off.../

text.obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_510_: * Susie^1? You want to ACT^1? Aww, what's your idea?/
text.obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_512_: * Umm..^1. well..^1. how do I say this./
text.obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_513_: * I kind of..^1.&* Need you for this one./
text.obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_516_: \E0* You want to apologize to it for earlier^1, right?/
text.obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_518_: * Nah^1, I just need you to stay still./%
text.obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_531_: * You explained to K. Round about the importance of dodging Susie's attacks./
text.obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_532_: * But it didn't seem to understand.../%
text.obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_535_: * You started making siren noises with your mouth and looking at Susie./
text.obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_540_: * You started explaining that Susie is really dangerous and strong./
text.obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_541_: * Susie got a large boost to her morale./
text.obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_578_: * Kris^1! We gotta get that CROWN off its head!/
text.obj_checkers_enemy_slash_Step_0_gml_579_: * Help me throw Ralsei at it!/%

text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_105_0: * KING's mouths gave a berserk smile.
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_169_0: * KING - Abandoned by the Lightners^1, his heart became cracked with hatred./
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_170_0: * He cannot be reasoned with^1, but don't give up...!/%
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_180_0: * You tried to reason with the King.../
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_183_0: * Your very existence goes against our own.../
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_184_0: \E0* By the Knight's will^1, I shall shatter your heart to pieces!/
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_201_0: * You encouraged the party^1!&* The party's DEFENSE raised for this turn!/%
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_214_0: * Susie tried to reason with the King.../
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_218_0: \EC* So if we can get by without hurting you^1, then.../
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_220_0: * If I perish^1, so be it!/
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_221_0: \E4* Show my son the monster you REALLY are!/
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_224_0: \E3* Arright^1, you wanna see what I can do^1, huh?/
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_226_0: * Susie's will is changing..^1.&* \cYTALK\cW became \cYRED BUSTER\cW!/%
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_241_0: * Your SOUL shined its power on Susie!/%
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_254_0: * Ralsei tried to reason with the King.../
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_256_0: * You might not realize it^1, but.../
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_257_0: \E6* This is a world where you don't have to fight./
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_258_0: \E8* I know if we try^1, we can all find another way.../
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_261_0: \E0* A shame you will not live to realize your naivety./
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_262_0: \E4* Now^1, perish with the pathetic LIGHTNERs you worship!/
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_264_0: * Sorry^1, my friends and I aren't going anywhere!/
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_266_0: * Ralsei's will is changing..^1.&* \cYTALK\cW became \cYDUAL HEAL\cW!/%
text.obj_king_boss_slash_Step_0_gml_282_0: * Your SOUL shined its power on RALSEI!/%
